verdicts.reason: SI-TRUST, part of Slovenia's Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration, administers SI-PASS and smsPASS, and the privacy notice says the data are processed in Slovenia with no transfers to third countries.
The controller is Slovenia's Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration (SI-TRUST), and the privacy notice says the data are processed only in Slovenia with no transfers to third countries.
The CAs are run by SI-TRUST, which sits within Slovenia's Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration, and the SI-PASS-CA signing certificates are stored at SI-TRUST itself.
Under the Weapons Act (ZOro-1), the records are kept on the central computer of Slovenia's Ministry of the Interior.

Article 6(2) of the 2025 law makes the publisher, the Slovenian Government Office for Legislation, responsible for developing and maintaining the gazette's information systems; the law names no external contractor, and this takes effect from 1 March 2026.
The Bank of Slovenia says TARGET payment infrastructure is developed and provided by the Eurosystem, which the definitions count as EU.

NIJZ, Slovenia's national public health institute, runs the CeZZ information system, and the central ICT is provided by a public company wholly owned by the Republic of Slovenia and required by law to have its seat in Slovenia.
ZDigZ makes the public company wholly owned by the Slovenian state the contractual processor for these public-health collections, and NIJZ is the controller.
